tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.title: List opportunities
tools.description: List innovation opportunities in the NOVI pipeline. Returns id, title, stage, industry, geography, owner, and creation date. Use `stage` to filter by pipeline stage and `limit` to cap results (default 25, max 200).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default 25, max 200).

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.title: Get opportunity
tools.description: Fetch the full record for a single innovation opportunity by id, including scoring, business plan, business case, strategic analyses, go-to-market plan, and gates.

tools.name: search_opportunities
tools.title: Search opportunities
tools.description: Full-text search opportunities by title, description, industry, technology, or solution. Returns id, title, stage, industry, and a short description snippet.

query.description: Search text to match across title, description, industry, technology, and solution.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default 25, max 100).
